'''Sportverein Horn''' is a [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Horn, Austria|Horn]], Austria, which competes in the [[Austrian Regionalliga East]], one of the third tiers of [[Football in Austria|Austrian football]]. 

Founded in 1922, SV Horn won the [[Landesliga Niederösterreich]] title in 1991, 1998, and 2007. In 2008, the club claimed the [[Austrian Cup]] by defeating [[SV Feldkirchen]] in the final, although clubs from the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga]] and the [[2. Liga (Austria)|Second Division]] did not participate in that edition of the competition. SV Horn subsequently contested the unofficial [[Austrian Supercup]] in 2008, where they were defeated 7–1 by [[SK Rapid Wien|Rapid Wien]].

On 8 June 2015, Japanese international [[Keisuke Honda]]'s management company, Honda ESTILO—run by his brothers Hiroyuki and Youji—acquired a 49% stake in the club.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nikkansports.com/m/soccer/news/1487958_m.html?mode=all | script-title=ja:本田オーストリア３部クラブ買収へ、実質オーナーに | language = ja}}</ref> In 2018, the investment group sold its shares, returning the club to local ownership.<ref>{{cite news |title=2.
